title: Checkout API 5xx rate above threshold

entry.query: fields @timestamp, @message, requestId | filter status >= 500 | sort @timestamp desc

trace.label: checkout-service
trace.query: fields @timestamp, @message, level, service | filter requestId = 'REQUEST_ID' | sort @timestamp desc

cases.description: The payments provider timed out and the retry succeeded.
cases.prose: A read timeout against the payments provider that the client retry already recovered. No action while the retry rate stays inside its own alarm.
followUps: Confirm the provider's retry rate is inside its own alarm before closing.

cases.description: A null SKU from the inventory feed, tracked upstream.
cases.prose: The inventory feed occasionally emits a record with no SKU, which the checkout mapper rejects with a 500. Tracked upstream; the alarm clears once the feed is republished.
cases.resolution: Wait for the inventory feed to republish, then confirm the alarm clears.

followUps: Attach the correlated request IDs to the incident before escalating.
